name: source-event-envelope-v1
title: Source event envelope v1
purpose: Canonical, machine-readable identity and continuity contract for a single source event. This is a specification of the wire/identity envelope only; it does not grant rights, admit a dataset, or assert a market data claim.

freeze_binding.note: A conforming envelope is necessary but never sufficient for admission. No evidence token, URL, checksum or digest in this envelope is a rights grant.

canonicalization.json: JSON object with unique string keys; no duplicate members; integers are decimal, not floats
canonicalization.digest_input: All envelope members except envelope_digest, sorted by key, serialized with json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)

fields.name: schema_version
rules: Must equal 1 exactly.

fields.name: source_id
rules: Must be non-empty after no trimming; whitespace-only is invalid.

fields.name: source_product_ref
rules: Must be a non-empty reference to a versioned source-product record. It is a reference, not an entitlement.

fields.name: session_ref
rules: Must be a non-empty reference to a source session. Per-session monotonicity is scoped to this value.

fields.name: decoder_version
rules: Must be a non-empty versioned decoder identifier. Required as evidence for VALIDATED.

fields.name: reference_data_revision
rules: Must be a non-empty reference-data revision identifier. Required as evidence for VALIDATED.

fields.name: rights_evidence_ref
rules: Must be a non-empty reference to rights evidence; the reference never grants rights and is never inferred from a URL token or checksum.

fields.name: connection_epoch
rules: Must be greater than 0.

fields.name: capture_sequence
rules: Must be greater than 0 and strictly increasing within a (source_id, session_ref) scope.

fields.name: canonical_sequence
rules: Must be greater than 0 and strictly increasing within a (source_id, session_ref) scope; it is assigned by canonicalization, never by the provider.

fields.name: provider_sequence
rules: Must be null or an integer greater than 0; 0 is invalid.
Null means the provider did not supply a sequence. No sequence may be synthesized, inferred or backfilled.

fields.name: source_timestamp_ns
rules: Must be null or an integer in the u64 range. No source time is synthesized when null.

fields.name: receive_utc_ns
rules: Must be greater than 0.

fields.name: receive_monotonic_ns
rules: Must be greater than 0; monotonic receive time is never derived from UTC time.

fields.name: raw_frame_digest
rules: Must match ^[0-9a-f]{64}$. Uppercase hex, short or long digests are invalid.

fields.name: envelope_digest
rules: Must match ^[0-9a-f]{64}$.
Must equal SHA-256 of the canonical sorted-key JSON of all other fields, with no field omitted except envelope_digest itself.

fields.name: quality_state
rules: Must be one of CAPTURED, DECODED, VALIDATED, QUARANTINED.

fields.name: continuity_state
rules: Must be one of CONTINUOUS, GAP_SUSPECTED, RECOVERED, UNKNOWN.

validation_rules.rule: Reject any envelope whose member set differs from the ordered field list above; no unknown, missing or duplicate members.
Reject unless connection_epoch > 0 and receive_utc_ns > 0 and receive_monotonic_ns > 0.
Reject a repeated or decreasing capture_sequence or canonical_sequence for the same (source_id, session_ref).
Reject provider_sequence == 0 and reject any synthesized provider_sequence; null is the only absence value.
Reject a digest that is not 64 lowercase hex characters; recompute envelope_digest over all other fields and reject on mismatch.
VALIDATED requires a non-empty decoder_version and a non-empty reference_data_revision, and continuity_state must not be GAP_SUSPECTED or UNKNOWN.
QUARANTINED envelopes are never admissible to replay, research or publication.
No rights, collection, market-data or live-execution permission is implied by a valid envelope.

rejection_reason_codes.condition: member set differs from the canonical field list
a required non-empty string is empty or whitespace-only
capture_sequence repeats or decreases within a session
canonical_sequence repeats or decreases within a session
provider_sequence is 0 or otherwise outside u64-or-null
a provider sequence was inferred, synthesized or backfilled
source_timestamp_ns is neither null nor a u64
receive_utc_ns or receive_monotonic_ns is not greater than 0
raw_frame_digest or envelope_digest is not 64 lowercase hex characters
recomputed digest does not equal envelope_digest
VALIDATED without decoder_version or reference_data_revision evidence
VALIDATED with GAP_SUSPECTED or UNKNOWN continuity

negative_cases.case: capture_sequence repeats in the same session
canonical_sequence decreases in the same session
envelope_digest computed with a missing field

source_verification.purpose: Machine-readable scan instruction for scripts/check_contracts.py; independent implementations must be present at the exact heads recorded in CURRENT-STATE.json.
source_verification.field_name_tokens_are: the name of every entry in fields, in ordinal order
